summary:
Iteration 6 = code-quality regression pass (DOMPurify XSS, context memoization, empty-catch logging, RichEditor deps, article paragraph key hash, CustomLayoutSection arts memo). Backend: 44/44 previously-passing tests (phase4 + phase5) re-run on public preview URL — all PASS (4.83s). No backend files changed. Frontend: home loads with breaking ticker, left sidebar Latest News with time-ago stamps, hero + secondary articles, category nav — all render. Article page /article/ renders bilingual bodies with

, images and formatting intact after DOMPurify sanitization. Language toggle (EN ↔ BN) switches all header/nav/article strings without infinite loop or console errors — memoized contexts safe. Admin flow: /login with rahipatrika@gmail.com/Thanksc#2u -> POST /api/auth/login 200 -> redirects to /admin, header shows Rahi user chip. All admin subroutes reachable: /admin, /admin/breaking, /admin/categories, /admin/sidebar, /admin/layout. Logout via header dropdown ([data-testid*=logout]) succeeds, clears session (subsequent /admin -> /login redirect). No page/JS errors. Only console noise is expected 401s from unauthenticated /api/auth/me polls (pre-existing).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1408 lines; still recommended to split into routers (auth, articles, breaking, categories, sidebar, layouts) for maintainability — carry-over from iter5, not addressed but not blocking.

The /api/auth/me endpoint returns 401 for anon users on every page load, producing repeated console errors in the browser devtools. AuthContext.fetchMe already logs only non-401 errors (correct), but the underlying fetch still surfaces the 401 in devtools network tab — consider swallowing it at the api client for cleaner console (nice-to-have).
DOMPurify default profile is used — good default. If article body ever needs to embed iframe/video, that will need explicit ADD_TAGS config.
test_credentials.md line 14 still references the dead rahi-news-portal URL — cosmetic, still valid warning.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (home, article, language toggle, login, admin routes, logout)

test_credentials: Admin rahipatrika@gmail.com / Thanksc#2u — VERIFIED via /api/auth/login 200 and full UI login flow
seed_data_creation: None persisted; backend regression tests self-cleanup
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter6 is a code-quality fix pass with zero functional regressions. Backend unchanged so backend_test_phase4/phase5 still valid. Frontend logout button carries data-testid containing 'logout' inside the header user dropdown (open by clicking 'Rahi' user chip in header). No new features to test.
